title: Count Visited Nodes in a Directed Graph
summary: Given a directed graph with n nodes and edges, for each node i, return the count of distinct nodes visited when starting from node i and following edges until a previously visited node is encountered.
statement: Given a directed graph with n nodes and edges, for each node i, return the count of distinct nodes visited when starting from node i and following edges until a previously visited node is encountered.
constraints: Every node has exactly one outgoing edge edges[i].
For every start, return the number of distinct nodes visited before the first repeat.
reference_solution:
def count_functional_graph_visits(edges):
    n=len(edges);answer=[0]*n;state=[0]*n
    for start in range(n):
        if answer[start]:continue
        path=[];position={};node=start
        while not answer[node] and node not in position:position[node]=len(path);path.append(node);node=edges[node]
        if answer[node]:base=answer[node]
        else:
            cycle_start=position[node];cycle=len(path)-cycle_start
            for item in path[cycle_start:]:answer[item]=cycle
            path=path[:cycle_start];base=cycle
        for item in reversed(path):base+=1;answer[item]=base
    return answer
